timeframe: 5m completed candles, Bollinger 20 close SMA, population std, 2 sigma
prior_approach: Within six completed candles ending at first wick, at least three lows strictly below their respective lower bands for longs, highs above upper bands for shorts. Last breach is farther outward than the first. Six-bar close displacement in incoming direction at least 1 first-anchor ATR(14), band midpoint slopes in incoming direction.
brief_pause: Between anchor and trigger candle require 2 to 5 fully completed 5m candles. Their combined high-low range <=1.5 anchor ATR and absolute first-open to last-close change <=0.5 ATR. No extension through first extreme. The baseline requires a separate visit before the second, strictly higher low/lower high.
entry: Keep original first favorable tick of second probe and existing times. No wait for the trigger candle to close, no breakout entry. No retroactive entry after pause filter fails.
assessment: Fixed after Nov 21 KST closed, initial comparisons retrospective; genuinely new whole KST days from Nov 23. Same sizing, initial stop, costs and portfolio. Individual and combined 60d net >=10% with adequate trades, independent stability and stress. No live change until corroborated.
